appDescription.overviewContent: The application is designed to help children with autism improve their cognitive, behavioral, and social skills through a series of educational games and personalized activities. It uses adapted pedagogical methodologies, such as positive reinforcement, structured and predictable exercises, and the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to personalize activities based on the child’s progress and needs. The main goal of the application is to make learning interactive, accessible, and fun, while considering the sensory and cognitive particularities of children with autism. The simple and streamlined interface ensures smooth navigation, avoiding sensory overload.
appDescription.gameContent: The "Game" screen offers playful activities aimed at developing cognitive and motor skills, such as puzzles and memory games, helping children improve their logic and focus while having fun.
appDescription.motoContent: The "Moto Skills" screen is designed to work on fine motor skills through activities like guided drawing and the manipulation of virtual objects, promoting eye-hand coordination.
appDescription.interactionContent: The "Interaction" screen focuses on teaching social rules through simulations and interactive scenarios, allowing children to learn essential social behaviors like greeting, waiting their turn, and recognizing facial expressions.
appDescription.communicationContent: Finally, the "communication" screen supports the development of communication skills by enabling children to express themselves using pictograms and simple sentences, while enhancing their ability to convey needs, emotions, or thoughts.
appDescription.feedbackContent: Each screen in the application provides immediate feedback in the form of visual and auditory rewards, such as badges, animations, and pleasant sounds, to reinforce the children’s motivation and encourage active participation. These features are complemented by progress tracking, offering parents and educators detailed reports and suggestions for personalized exercises.

aboutA.title: About
aboutA.descriptionA: MOBIDICAL is an educational app designed to support children with autism in developing their cognitive, social, and motor skills through a personalized and playful approach.
aboutA.DevelopedBy:
Developed By : Chayma Ben Afia, Maha Khlifa
University: ISSAT Kairouan
Organization: Mobelite
aboutA.technologyText: The app is developed using React Native (TypeScript), with a Node.js/Express backend, PostgreSQL database, Firebase for authentication, and AI models in Python (speech recognition, OpenCV, TensorFlow…) to personalize learning.
aboutA.legalText: MOBIDICAL complies with data protection regulations (GDPR, COPPA). All data is encrypted and handled with the utmost confidentiality. The app is secured via JWT authentication and an API Gateway.
